verdict.rationale: a-Shell's `config` command changes the font, font size, background color, text color, and cursor color and shape, and `config -p` makes these settings permanent for all future windows. It also supports named themes (`config --theme`, with `-g` to save in Settings), JSON color schemes in Windows Terminal format, and custom .ttf/.otf fonts registered via `config --fonts`. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration beyond the first-party README.
